ov: Fifteen species of large New World monkeys, the most widespread primate genus in the Neotropics. They are famous for howls that carry through dense rainforest, made with an enlarged hyoid bone in the throat, and are the only New World monkeys that mainly eat leaves.
len: 56–92 cm, plus a tail about as long
rg: Forests of Central and South America.
df: Mainly top-canopy leaves, plus fruit, buds, flowers and nuts.
fx: Their noses are so keen they can smell food up to 2 km away.
Unlike other New World monkeys, both males and females have full (trichromatic) colour vision.
